answer: The 39.1% headline is the reduction of 2025 market-based Scope 1 and 2 emissions of 2,440 ktCO2e from the 2018 baseline of 4,010 ktCO2e; (4,010 - 2,440) / 4,010 is approximately 39.15%, which rounds to 39.1%.

evidence.quote: 39.1% ... 2025: 2,440 kt ... reduction is measured against the 2018 baseline: 4,010 ktCO2e emissions
